class MyScanner {
public:
    std::istream& in;
    std::string token;
    std::istringstream iss;

    MyScanner() : in(cin) {}

    std::string next() {
        while (!(iss >> token)) {
            std::string line;
            std::getline(in, line);
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return std::stoi(next());
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        return std::stoll(next());
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        return std::stod(next());
    }
    std::string nextLine() {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(in, line);
        return line;
    }
};

int main() {
    MyScanner sc;
    std::ostream& out = std::cout;

    std::string str = sc.nextLine();
    std::vector<char> inp(str.begin(), str.end());
    int n = str.length();

    std::vector<std::string> pos = { "00", "25", "50", "75" };
    int count = 0;

    if (inp.size() == 1) {
        if (inp[0] == '0' || inp[0] == 'X' || inp[0] == '_') count++;
    } else {

        for (const std::string& cstr : pos) {
            int X = -1;
            int idx = 0;
            bool possible = true;

            for (int i = n - 2; i < n; i++) {
                char curr = inp[i];
                char strcurr = cstr[idx++];
                if (curr == '_') continue;
                else if (curr == 'X') {
                    if (X == -1) {
                        X = (strcurr - '0');
                    } else {
                        if (X != (strcurr - '0')) {
                            possible = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    if (curr != strcurr) {
                        possible = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!possible) continue;

            if (str.length() == 2) {
                if (cstr[0] == '0') continue;
                count++;
                continue;
            }

            std::vector<char> ninp = inp;
            int cntX = 0;
            for (char ch : inp) {
                if (ch == 'X') cntX++;
            }

            if (X != -1 || cntX == 0) {
                if (X != -1) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < str.size(); k++) {
                        if (inp[k] == 'X') ninp[k] = (char)(X + '0');
                    }
                }
                if (ninp[0] == '0') continue;
                long long counter = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < str.size() - 2; k++) {
                    if (ninp[k] == '_') {
                        if (k == 0) {
                            counter *= 9;
                        } else {
                            counter *= 10;
                        }
                    }
                }
                count += counter;
            } else {
                if (ninp[0] == '0') continue;

                long long counter = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < str.size() - 2; k++) {
                    if (ninp[k] == '_') {
                        if (k == 0) {
                            counter *= 9;
                        } else {
                            counter *= 10;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (ninp[0] == 'X') {
                    counter *= 9;
                } else {
                    counter *= 10;
                }
                count += counter;
            }
        }
    }

    out << count << "\n";

    return 0;
}
